title: Russian night attacks kill 1 in Kyiv, leave 350,000 in Dnipro without power
summary: In Kyiv, multiple Russian ballistic missiles struck just after 10 p.m. local time. According to Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko, warehouse buildings in the city's Darnitsky district were struck, starting fires.

title: Seven Russian tankers shipping diesel to US identified, located
summary: A live tracker map developed by Greenpeace, an international environmental organization, shows Russian tankers currently moving across the Atlantic Ocean, with one vessel approaching the U.S. East Coast.

title: Drone attack reportedly kills worker at Russian-occupied Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant
summary: The plant has repeatedly faced threats to nuclear safety, including drone attacks, disruptions to external power supplies, and incidents affecting plant workers.

title: Oleshky evacuation begins but volunteer claims Russia already moved people outside of agreed terms
summary: "Everyone who wishes to leave Oleshky will be given the opportunity to leave safely. At the same time, those who have decided to stay can stay and will receive all the necessary humanitarian support," Ukraine's Human Rights Ombudsman Dmytro Lubinets said.

title: Russia's legal siege over assets continues, costing Euroclear hundreds of millions of euros in 2026
summary: Euroclear is facing "multiple proceedings in Russian courts," including a case launched by the Russian Central Bank that seeks to challenge the immobilization of its assets.

title: Russian attacks across Ukraine kill 27, injure 127 over past day as 'horrific attack' strikes Dnipro train station
summary: Beyond strikes on Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, Russia launched ballistic missiles, four guided aerial missiles, and 113 Shahed-type drones, including 83 jet-powered drones, against Ukraine overnight on Oct. 30, according to Ukraine's Air Force.

title: EU announces two new drone technology hubs, backed by Ukrainian know-how
summary: "In developing drones and counter-drone systems, Europe has one significant advantage: our partnership with Ukraine," said European Commissioner Valdis Dombrovskis.

title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,586,500 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
summary: The number includes 1,590 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

title: Ukraine reportedly strikes Russian oil refinery in Samara
summary: The reported attack is being called a ‘resumption of strikes’ on various monitoring channels, being the first after an unofficial pause on Ukraine’s campaign against oil refineries that began in mid-October.
